warning.titlePre: Jaguar XF 2.0d Ingenium Diesel Timing Chain Wear
paragraphs: If your XF 2.0d is from the X260 generation (2015–~2020) with the Ingenium AJ200D diesel engine, timing chain wear is a well-documented pattern across this engine family. We replace the timing chain, injector seals, EGR components and gaskets as standard on every XF 2.0d rebuild.
The petrol XF variants — P250 and P300 — use the same Ingenium AJ200 petrol engine, which does not share this specific diesel timing chain issue.
warning.source: Source: widely corroborated across JLR specialist forums and independent garages, consistent with broader Ingenium pattern per G-BRF-Jaguar.md. Petrol variants explicitly excluded from this claim per VRF, correctly scoped to diesel-badged X260 variants.
